business_problem: With the opportunity to expand into new markets but with a need for better performance and flexibility, Enterprise Bot , an enterprise generative artificial intelligence (AI) company, migrated from a previous cloud provider to Amazon Web Services (AWS).
solution_summary: With the opportunity to expand into new markets but with a need for better performance and flexibility, Enterprise Bot , an enterprise generative artificial intelligence (AI) company, migrated from a previous cloud provider to Amazon Web Services (AWS). Using AWS, the company enhances customer and employee support with AI offerings that deliver more accurate and concise responses for users and customer service agents. Migrating to AWS for Better Flexibility and Speed Founded in 2017 and based in Switzerland, Enterprise Bot brings cutting-edge generative AI capabilities to enterprises by offering sophisticated AI bots with the option to choose from multiple large language models (LLMs). The company built its platform in the cloud, but with the LLM and generative AI landscape evolving rapidly, its previous cloud provider couldn't meet the growing demands for performance and flexibility.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Runs the foundation model layer for the customer and agent support workflows.
